acceptance_gates.boundary: Development and contaminated held-out labels cannot establish confirmatory superiority even if a descriptive difference exists.
acceptance_gates.selection_rule: Fixed capability-envelope baseline: matched predicate input, effect-side observation, and non-AttestFlow generic trace localization. No outcome-dependent winner selection.

claim_evidence_boundary.boundary: These are same-team synthetic cases; the original held_out label is contaminated and nonconfirmatory.
claim_evidence_boundary.claim: The frozen synthetic schedule was analyzed without silently dropping missing or indeterminate cells.

claim_evidence_boundary.boundary: A failed gate narrows the claim; equality is not reported as superiority.
claim_evidence_boundary.claim: A_FULL's descriptive detection and localization were compared with the fixed strongest baseline and its ablations.

claim_evidence_boundary.boundary: Synthetic same-harness observation alone does not establish observer independence.
claim_evidence_boundary.claim: The effect-side ablation changed at least one synthetic conclusion if listed in the evidence.
